People.want: Wants to access the CCC Agency Portal to log in
People.knowledgeLevel: Using an old office laptop with an older browser; unsure whether it's Internet Explorer or old Edge; does not have administrator privileges to install updates
People.role: Agency user from FFF Agency calling support about the CCC Agency Portal

People.want: Wants to resolve the agency user's portal access issue quickly
People.knowledgeLevel: Knows the CCC Agency Portal no longer supports older browsers and requires the latest Chrome or Edge
People.role: Operator at AAA Insurance Dealer Support providing system guidance

Issue.title: Cannot load the CCC Agency Portal login page
Issue.description: On the old office laptop, the CCC Agency Portal shows a spinning white screen and the login box never appears.

Issue.title: Cannot install or update browser due to lack of administrator privileges
Issue.description: When attempting to update the browser, a pop-up requests Administrator Privileges, and the caller does not have the admin password.

Solution.title: Update the web browser to the latest Chrome or Edge
Solution.description: Use a supported browser because the CCC Agency Portal no longer supports older browsers; update to the latest Chrome or Edge.

Solution.title: Contact the agency’s local IT administrator to authorize the browser update
Solution.description: Ask the FFF Agency local IT admin to log in with admin rights and approve/install the necessary browser update.
